lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the largest clusters concentrated in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp, horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Multiple small, high-intensity pixel clusters are distributed across the surface of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark, horizontal linear mark is visible on the upper mid-flank, interrupting the standard repeating pattern of high-luminance blobs.
